choices.why: The light ash desk with tapered legs is the most Nordic option, and at 118 cm it fits neatly beside the window without crowding the space.
This white bentwood swivel chair on castors is comfortable for working and keeps the palette light and Scandinavian, in harmony with the pale wood of the desk.
It is tall and 90 cm wide, with white-stained wood that blends into the white right-hand wall while holding plenty of books.
The light birch bentwood rocking chair with an off-white cushion is cosy for reading and matches the Nordic style and the pale woods.
Its swing arm aims the light over the armchair for reading, and its white shade softens the space.

answer.why: Pale wood, white tones and soft curves create a bright, cohesive Nordic corner that complements the wood-look floor and the white walls, letting the light from the large window take centre stage.
